Subject: Unit Economics Dashboard v1: scope tradeoffs + exec readout draft (need edits + dates)

Hi Evelyn (+ team),

Sharing a draft exec readout for the Unit Economics dashboard v1 and a 1-pager on scope tradeoffs since we’re making a couple cuts to hit the 10–12 week window.

Attachments:
- Executive Readout - Unit Economics Dashboard v1 (Draft 2025-02-03).docx
- V1 Scope (Unit Econ Dashboard) - delta vs PRD (2025-02-03).pdf

Asks:
1) Edits on messaging: what we can confidently claim in v1 vs where we need explicit caveats (esp. reconciliation + metering parity).
2) Confirm target dates for (a) Finance signoff on methodology, (b) internal dogfood launch, and (c) exec readout slot.

Current proposed dates (please adjust):
- Methodology signoff (CFO/FP&A): Fri 2/14
- Dogfood to Product/Eng/Finance (feature-flagged): Tue 2/18
- Exec readout (leadership staff): week of 2/24

Key scope tradeoffs we’re proposing for v1 (details in 1-pager):
- Ship v1 drilldowns: model (incl. version), region (normalized), customer tier (self-serve/dedicated/private/enterprise).
- Include contributing signals v1: cache hit rate, batching utilization, avg output length, streaming vs non-streaming.
- Defer v1.1: top-N by “route” (too much cardinality risk), “customer-level” breakdowns (privacy), and deeper quantization slicing beyond “profile group” (need guardrails + naming stability).

Open question for leadership: do we want to position this as “finance-aligned blended cost” (primary) with “live view” as a secondary view, or keep the readout to only the finance-aligned methodology until we’ve seen a full month of stable data?

Thanks — would love feedback by EOD Wed if possible so we can lock the comms + dates.

-Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference

Thanks.

Two things I want tightened in the readout:
1) The definition of “blended $/1M output tokens” needs to be stated once, crisply, and then we should stop re-litigating it in the narrative. Put the reconciliation caveats in a callout box.
2) The “what’s in v1 / what’s not in v1” slide should be explicit about “no automated actions” and “internal-only.”

On dates: I’m ok with week of 2/24 for an exec readout, but only if Laura + Rishi are comfortable we won’t be defending methodology in the meeting. If that’s not true, we should push to early March and do a smaller pre-brief with Finance + Dylan first.

Also: please add a single slide on “decision we want leadership to make,” not just “status.” If it’s just status we can do async.

Evelyn

Subject: Re: Unit Economics Dashboard v1: scope tradeoffs + exec readout draft (need edits + dates)

+1 to Evelyn.

From Finance POV, the biggest risk is calling something “finance-aligned” before we’ve validated:
- Rate card provenance + versioning (which quarter’s assumptions are applied, and how we handle changes)
- Idle capacity allocation (especially Dedicated pools)
- A reconciliation report that ties to our spend and metered tokens at a QTD level

If those three are in place, we can stand behind a week-of-2/24 readout.

I read the draft and have two edits:
1) Please remove the sentence that implies we’ll be “matching billing totals.” Billing is a different construct; we can say “reconciles within tolerance vs infrastructure spend + metering.”
2) Where you say “token metering parity is solved,” please soften. We’ve improved it, but I want to see sustained streaming parity checks before we declare victory.

Suggested: make “Finance view” the default in the exec readout; “Live view” can exist for Eng operators but should not be in the exec narrative until it’s stable.

Laura

—
Laura Bennett
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference

Marissa — quick FP&A notes.

I’m aligned to the v1 scope cut of route-level drilldowns. That’s the right trade vs reliability and cardinality.

For signoff by 2/14, we need two concrete artifacts ready by then (even if internal only):
1) “Methodology v1” page with:
   - cost inputs (rate card source, refresh cadence)
   - allocation basis (what costs are included/excluded)
   - treatment of idle + overhead
   - known limitations (esp. regional mapping edge cases)
2) Reconciliation view:
   - QTD totals by tier and by region
   - deltas explained (missing dims, late arriving usage, etc.)

Re: exec readout: I’d recommend we keep it to 4 slides:
- Why this matters (and what decisions it enables)
- Definition (one slide)
- Where we are vs goals (coverage/freshness/SLO)
- Next 30 days (and the specific leadership decision Evelyn requested)

Happy to review a revised draft tomorrow.

Rishi

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of FP&A
Redwood Inference

Agree with the scope call and Finance-first framing.

Eng reality check on dates:
- 2/18 dogfood is doable IF we treat it as “internal beta” and accept that quant profile tagging will be partial for older traffic (needs backfill). We can still show model/region/tier reliably.
- For exec readout week of 2/24, I’d want (a) the reconciliation report running end-to-end at least once and (b) SRE alerts for freshness/completeness enabled, otherwise we’ll spend the meeting on “can we trust this.”

Marissa: in the readout draft, can you add a small “confidence indicator” concept? E.g., coverage % by hour and % of tokens missing a required dimension. That’s the simplest way to be honest without caveating every chart.

Also: please make the “what decisions this enables” concrete:
- identify outlier models/regions driving blended cost
- detect regressions when caching/batching changes roll out
- prioritize runtime work by $ impact

Dylan

Got it. I’ll revise tonight with the following changes:

- Exec readout tightened to 4–5 slides with one crisp definition slide + a reconciliation/limitations callout.
- Remove “matches billing totals” language; replace with “reconciles within tolerance vs infra spend + metering inputs,” and note what’s out-of-scope.
- Default framing as “Finance view” only; keep “Live view” as operator detail, not part of leadership narrative.
- Add a “leadership decision” slide. Proposed decision to ask for: approve v1 launch gating criteria + approve resourcing for v1.1 (quant profile slicing + quality guardrail integration) vs other Optimize priorities.
- Add a small confidence indicator (coverage %, missing-dimension %, freshness lag) on any chart slide.

On dates, proposal based on the feedback:
- Finance/FP&A methodology + reconciliation signoff target stays Fri 2/14 (with the two artifacts Rishi listed).
- Dogfood target Tue 2/18 as “internal beta” with an explicit banner for partial quant tagging/backfill.
- Exec readout: tentatively hold week of 2/24, but I’ll pencil a fallback to week of 3/3 if Finance signoff slips or if reconciliation/SLOs aren’t green.

I’ll send Rev B by tomorrow noon for inline comments.

-Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
